column2: Krillin wants to thank Android 18 but doesn't know what to bring. Help him with some diamonds and flowers.
Gero's lab still has old Red Ribbon combat robots on standby. Destroy them before they wake up.
With Gero's blueprints, Bulma can build a remote to shut down the androids. Bring her copper, redstone and gold.
Piccolo wants to know if you could hold Cell back the way Tien did. Spar with Tien, then report to Piccolo.
Mr. Popo says the Hyperbolic Time Chamber is about more than fighting. Enter it, reach Meditation level 3 and talk to him.
Babidi's ship is still guarded by Pui Pui. Find the ship and defeat him.
Majin Buu gets grumpy without sweets. Visit Buu's house and gather cookies, cakes and pumpkin pies.
Gohan needs a partner to keep the peace. Defeat pillagers and vindicators, then report to him.
Goten and Trunks have run off to play. Search a dark forest, a jungle and the badlands, then tell Gohan you found them.
The Old Kai believes a true warrior must feel ki, not just see it. Learn Ki Sense on the Sacred World of the Kais and show him.
Fortuneteller Baba's crystal ball is cracked. Bring her glass and amethyst to make a new one.
Goku is starving as usual. Catch two giant fish, cook them and bring the meal to his house.
A certain mysterious old man wants a rematch at full power. Defeat Jackie Chun and report back to Roshi.
Master Roshi's fridge is empty again. Bring him cod and bread so training can continue.
Master Korin needs seeds to grow a new batch of Senzu Beans. Bring him the seeds and he'll share a few.
Mr. Popo takes care of the garden at Kami's Lookout. Bring him flowers to replant it.
Red Ribbon soldiers still guard their base. Find the Red Ribbon Army base and take out their troops.
With Oolong gone, the villagers still fear the night. Clear out the zombies and skeletons that roam nearby.
With Gomah gone, Goku wants a real fight. Meet him on the plains: he climbs from his base form through Super Saiyan and Super Saiyan 2 up to Super Saiyan 3. Talk to him afterwards.
Bulma wants to study majilite, an ore hidden in the rocks of the Second Demon World. Mine 16 pieces and bring them to her.
Bulma found a Demon Realm merchant who sells Medi-Bugs. Bring her emeralds and gold ingots and she will order a batch, a Beetle pair included. You can buy again once an hour.
Goku is still getting used to his small body and wants a sparring partner. Spar with Mini Goku in his base form.
Before you leave Earth, Piccolo wants to see how strong you really are. Spar with him, then talk to him.
The Grand Elder wants to replant the trees burned by Frieza's army. Bring him water, saplings and bone meal.
Dende never forgot who helped the Namekians. Visit him at the Lookout and bring him golden apples.
Guldo and Recoome are back on their feet and looking for revenge. Defeat them both on Namek.
Learn the lay of the land on Namek: visit the Namekian rivers, the Ajissa Plains and the ruins of a village.
Frieza's soldiers carry useful scouter parts. Defeat 12 of them and gather redstone and glass panes to rebuild one.
Goku is leaving on Shenron's back. Visit his house one last time and say goodbye.
Liang Xing Long's poison lingers in the swamps. Clear out the slimes breeding in the smog and bring back lily pads to prove the water is clean.
With the gate between worlds broken, the undead are roaming the Earth. Put down the zombies, skeletons and wither skeletons that slipped out.
Luud's wreck is full of salvageable metal. Collect iron, copper and gold ingots to patch up the ship's hull.
The Elder Kai gets bored between rituals. Bring him some books and a cake for his trouble.
Pan refuses to be left behind again. Spar with her, then report back to Gohan.
The search for the Black Star Dragon Balls could take a whole year. Stock Bulma's ship with food before it leaves.
Baby's eggs are still hiding inside Earth's people. Bring water and bottles to Dende at Kami's Lookout so he can prepare the Sacred Water that cures them.
Uub's village barely has enough to eat. Bring Goku bread, cooked beef and seeds to send home with Uub.
